manual_read: Installed manual pp181-183 and 305-307: preparation follows assignment; post-mission turnround retains system with mission until task completion and DURN is calendar time.
limits: One aircraft and one fixed mission type with deterministic no-resource turnround; no repairs, PM or broader schedule generalization.
Native event log identifies preassignment at 23.75 but not the scheduler's internal candidate search; report state bins are time averages rather than instantaneous state at midnight.
The local unpublished v1.0.0 failed-cutoff probe is excluded from this v1.0.1 acceptance.
GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity were not tested.
